title: One command runs the frozen A/B/C matrix from the prereg units on one harness sha, resumable
body:
Evidence: .krn/runs/lead/night/proof-path.md; grant memory proof-redesign-grant (2026-11-18).
Outcome: node evals/replay/run.ts --prereg runs arms A, B and C over the prereg unit list on one pinned harness sha and resumes after a stop; arm A no longer needs --screen (evals/replay/run.ts:195).
Files: evals/replay/run.ts, evals/replay/abc.ts
Proof: a 3-unit 1-rep live run writes 9 rows and --report --strict names only incomplete.
